description:
JANUS is the Erasmus Mundus master in security and defence coordinated from Université Jean Moulin Lyon 3, with mandatory mobility between Lyon and Beirut Saint-Joseph and options in Granada, Bucharest and Essex. The first cohort's applications closed on 6 March 2026, and the 2027-2029 round is expected to follow the same early-March pattern.

Programme Highlights

  • Distinctive security-and-defence curriculum with Lyon-Beirut core mobility
  • Specialisations in cybersecurity, criminology and high-intensity warfare
  • Professional exposure through site visits (Interpol, NATO) and internships
  • Erasmus Mundus scholarships covering fees plus living allowance

Who Should Apply

Backgrounds in law, political science, international relations, economics, history or security/defence studies are welcomed; French is not a prerequisite since the programme runs in English with language support.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships cover tuition and provide a monthly allowance for travel and living costs.

Deadline and How to Apply

Watch the JANUS how-to-apply page for the 2027-2029 call and submit before the early-March cut-off. Key deadline information: 6 March 2027 (23:59 Paris time, expected — the first round closed 6 March 2026).
